audit_scope: Read-only interpretation of sealed V7, V8 and V9 raw CLI records. Only this new audit artifact is written. No experimental inference or frozen source/evidence changes.

limitations: This audit covers only the named V7, V8 and V9 campaigns; readiness probes and coordinating-agent work are excluded.

A published version tag and saved CLI version string agree, but this audit does not rebuild the binary to attest correspondence to source. Observed local total/last counter evidence independently establishes cumulative behavior.
Hidden provider requests, internal retries or substitutions cannot be excluded by CLI JSONL; billing actuals are unknown.
The original token counters and their stop consequences remain in sealed evidence. Correcting interpretation does not retroactively execute unlaunched tasks or establish their outcomes.
Reasoning_output_tokens is a component of output_tokens, not an extra amount to add. Cached_input_tokens is a component of input_tokens.

stop_interpretation.counterfactual_at_same_observed_point: A correctly deduplicated CLI output counter would be 189,372 at that point, below 1,000,000. It would not trigger that token threshold on this observed prefix.
stop_interpretation.effect_on_findings: Request, execution, answer, abstention, session and elapsed-time observations do not change. Completed exposure and censoring must remain 228/288 tasks and approximately 43.6 minutes, not a completed 24-round or 7-hour persistence test.
stop_interpretation.observed: The predeclared sum-of-reported-counter launch stop was reached at 1,001,109 after 19 rounds in all 12 trajectories (228 tasks), leaving 60 planned tasks unlaunched. This is the known operational stop, preserved in sealed evidence.
stop_interpretation.unidentified_counterfactual: Cannot infer how many additional tasks would complete, their behavior, final token usage, or what later stop would occur if the counter had been implemented differently.

method.baseline: Only zero for a verified new CLI session: first call index1, no resume in argv, null resumed_session_id, matching thread.started ID, and first persisted session token_count total equals last. A missing initial snapshot, resumed initial call, missing baseline evidence or counter decrease yields unknown, never an assumed zero or a clamped delta.
method.billing: No billing records or server-side hidden-request accounting were inspected. Deduplicated totals are CLI-reported output-token estimates including reported reasoning tokens, not independently verified billable tokens or dollars.
method.estimator: For verified-baseline sessions with complete monotonic counters, sum consecutive counter differences (first counter minus zero). This equals one final/max cumulative snapshot per session. Sum session estimates once.
method.local_independent_check: Read only the rollout file matching each already-observed study session ID. Deduplicate identical token_count total snapshots. Match each raw CLI cumulative snapshot to a persisted total; compare its last_token_usage to that call delta, without treating duplicate notifications as extra usage.
method.ordering: Group all paths by native session ID, then order by finished_utc. V9 source and native_full arm paths are grouped together because they resume the same native session.
method.raw_input: Exactly one turn.completed usage object from every sealed call stdout JSONL, linked to its thread.started ID, call manifest and result metadata. Raw stdout includes reasoning and cache-write fields omitted by the harness meta aggregate.

primary_source.finding: usage_from_last_total maps ThreadTokenUsage.total fields to exec Usage; ThreadTokenUsageUpdated updates that stored total and TurnCompleted emits it.
